name: Klaus
self_text: Hey, I’m Klaus, a non‑binary Egyptian in my late 20s, nursing by day and a programming enthusiast by night. I love tackling problems together—silence while we code is my vibe, and I appreciate someone who can explain things when I’m stuck. I’m free on Saturday mornings, Saturday afternoons, or Sunday mornings, whether we meet in person or online. Outside work, I’m an amateur astronomer, chasing the stars after my shifts.

requests.request_text: I need you to be comfortable with complete silence while we work, and you must be available on Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or Sunday morning. I'd strongly prefer that you are into programming or statistics, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are the one who explains the material to me, but I won't rule you out over it. A big plus would be if you enjoy studying independently side by side, though this isn’t a deal‑breaker.
